## Summary

Describe the work being added or changed, its category, and its creative intent.

## Sources and inspiration

List source titles, spell cards, scenes, or other references. State when the composition is completely original.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have the right to share this contribution and have credited its sources and artists.
- [ ] Every work includes `art.txt`, `README.md`, and `metadata.yaml`.
- [ ] I checked width, alignment, tabs, and control characters in a monospaced terminal.
- [ ] A readable plain-text version exists alongside any colored or rendered version.
- [ ] This change contains no extracted game assets or unauthorized third-party work.
